use_async_completed_wait_cuda_streams: use the completed async context manager to wait for CUDA stream work to finish
use_async_completed_debug_timing: use the completed context manager with DEBUG_COMPLETED_TIME to log CUDA stream elapsed times
use_async_concurrent_run_on_stream: use the concurrent async context manager to run code on a CUDA stream from a queue
review_completed_grad_assertion: review the completed context manager assertion that torch is_grad_enabled does not change during execution
review_concurrent_stream_queue_lifecycle: review the concurrent context manager stream queue get and put lifecycle for CUDA streams
